applicability: Marketplace Portal service. Policy edition 2026-09-01. Collection Profile and CORE terms are separate.
content:
Login and payment passwords are separate credentials. Use the password for the operation being performed; a bank-card or HarborPay password is not the CedarPay payment password.

| Problem | Reset route |
|---|---|
| Forgotten login password | Select Forgot password on the login page and verify through the registered phone or email. |
| Forgotten payment password | Open My Account → Payment settings → Forgot old payment password. |
| No registered email | Use the mobile-number login and reset entry with the registered phone. |

Three consecutive incorrect attempts lock the corresponding credential for three hours. Resetting that credential through its verification route clears its lock and error count. Resetting the payment password does not reset the login password.

For “account does not exist”, check the phone country code and login identifier. A migrated account may require username login. For a system error, try a clean browser session and provide the screenshot if it persists.

Login identifiers cannot normally be changed or removed through a general account edit. A request to remove one of two login identifiers requires manual review, the customer's agreement to irreversible removal, identity evidence and the reason. Submitting that request does not guarantee that the removal will be approved.
